rules.quote: We’ve retired the 1M token context window beta (`context-1m-2025-08-07`) for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4.
rules.summary: Sends the `context-1m-2025-08-07` beta. On Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Sonnet 4 it has no effect since 2026-04-30 and requests over 200k tokens fail; moving to a model with a 1M window is a model decision, so it is listed for review.

rules.quote: Requests to the `/v1/files` endpoints, and Messages API requests that reference an uploaded file, no longer require the `files-api-2025-04-14`
rules.summary: Sends the `files-api-2025-04-14` beta, which is out of beta. Requests that keep sending it still work, so this is a cleanup to review, not a fix.
